verdict.rationale: Inngest documents flow control that thins noisy event streams. Rate limiting skips events that exceed a hard limit [inngest-docs-13]. Throttling, concurrency and keyed limits are also covered [inngest-docs-24, inngest-docs-12, inngest-docs-1]. Sleeps can delay work inside a run [inngest-docs-2]. However, nothing in the evidence documents debounce or event batching, which are the core collapse mechanisms the story names. Missing for 10: documented debounce, documented event batching, trigger-level delay (as opposed to in-run sleeps), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
